methodology.independent_sample: one randomly generated map; not one timing batch
methodology.timing: one warmup, repeated batches, median batch-average ms; default GC behavior
methodology.query_timing_includes: complete astar_search including validation and frontier operations
methodology.query_timing_excludes: BFS, heuristic verification, trace collection, plot/file IO, landmark preprocessing
methodology.preprocessing: landmark selection and all BFS distance tables included; each prefix k uses cumulative cost
methodology.total_time: preprocessing plus summed per-query median times; noisy machine-dependent estimate
methodology.no_path_cost_summary: unreachable optimal_steps=-1 kept in raw data, excluded from path length summaries
methodology.structure_confounders: all sizes/endpoints fixed; only long_wall vs scattered_50 additionally controls obstacle count; wall-gap experiment controls count and wall column
methodology.heuristic_quality: goal-connected finite-distance nodes only for admissibility/gap; consistency checked over all open directed edges
